source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.2.3 (Nomenclature of cycloalkanes) with Figure 11.3, printed page 249.

blocks.text: Cycloalkanes ke naam utne hi carbon atoms wale alkane ke naam se pehle prefix ‘cyclo’ laga kar rakhe jate hain. Maslan chhe carbon ka halqa cyclohexane hai. Figure 11.3 mein misalein hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar cyclohexane halqe, side chains condensed shakal mein. Ethylcyclohexane: halqe par CH2-CH3. Isopropylcyclohexane: H3C-CH-CH3, zanjeer ke number 1 aur 2; aam naam isopropylcyclohexane, IUPAC naam 1-methylethylcyclohexane. 1,1,4-Trimethylcyclohexane: halqa 1 se 4 tak number, carbon 4 par CH3 aur carbon 1 par H3C aur CH3. n-Propylcyclohexane: CH2-CH2-CH3; IUPAC naam propylcyclohexane.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.3: Cycloalkanes ke naam rakhna (kitab ki Figure 11.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har chhe-kona halqa cyclohexane hai; har kone par aik carbon (CH₂) hai jo likha nahi jata. Halqe par aik hi substituent ho to number ki zaroorat nahi (ethylcyclohexane). Kai substituents hon to halqe ko aise number dein ke sab se chhote numbers aayen: 1,1,4-trimethylcyclohexane mein carbon 1 par do CH₃ hain.

blocks.prompt: 2-Methylbutane aur 2,2-dimethylpropane ke structural formulas likhein, aur eicosane (20 carbon wala seedhi chain ka alkane) ka molecular formula batayein (Quick Check 11.1a, d).
blocks.explanation: 2-Methylbutane: CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃, chaar carbon ki chain jis ke carbon 2 par methyl hai. 2,2-Dimethylpropane: C(CH₃)₄, teen carbon ki chain jis ke carbon 2 par do methyl hain. Dono C₅H₁₂ hain. Eicosane: CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ mein n = 20 rakhein to C₂₀H₄₂.

blocks.prompt: 2,3,3-Trimethylhexane aur methylcyclohexane ke formulas likhein, aur cyclopentane aur pentane ke molecules mein do farq batayein (Quick Check 11.1b, c).
blocks.explanation: 2,3,3-Trimethylhexane: chhe carbon ki chain, carbon 2 par aik methyl aur carbon 3 par do: CH₃CH(CH₃)C(CH₃)₂CH₂CH₂CH₃. Methylcyclohexane: chhe carbon ka halqa jis ke aik carbon par CH₃ hai, C₇H₁₄. Cyclopentane (C₅H₁₀) ke paanch carbon halqe mein hain aur us mein pentane (C₅H₁₂) se do hydrogen kam hain; pentane ke carbon khuli chain banate hain aur us ke do CH₃ sire hain, halqe mein koi sira nahi.

items: Cycloalkane ka naam = cyclo + utne hi carbons wale alkane ka naam: ethylcyclohexane, (1-methylethyl)cyclohexane, propylcyclohexane, 1,1,4-trimethylcyclohexane.
